title: Shared projects in the Commons, the shops among them (SPEC §8.5–8.6)

cost.description: The House-building cost class it is priced from (× tuning commons.costMult).

tiers.description: One entry per level: the building tier each level is priced as.

requires.description: A project that must stand first (the shops need the Great Market).

unlockedBy.description: A campaign flag that must be set first (the Bastion of the Gate waits on the Year 5 assault, arc.ts).

mods.description: Battle mods every Scion carries, once per level standing (the Commons tech tree).
